capabilities: Track text from copy and cut events
Paste from a menu of recent clipboard texts
Configure history limit and view mode (hovered or docked)
extras: README lists clear limitations: only text content, only inside editing view, history kept in memory so it is lost between sessions and not shared across devices, and clipboard events outside Obsidian are not tracked. Includes suggested hotkeys (Ctrl/Cmd+Shift+V).
problem: Obsidian's paste only uses the most recent clipboard item, so previously copied text is lost.
summary: Clipboard history tool that lets you paste from recent copy and cut events in the editor.
